requirements: R1: Clear or retry the 5 failed Flow Core tasks to resolve BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_FRONTIER state

slices.title: Clear failed Flow Core tasks
slices.jtbd: When implementing the recovery patch for this epic, I want to clear the 5 failed tasks, so that the flow core can resume processing active work
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given Flow Core is in BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_FRONTIER state with failed tasks
When the backend patch is applied to clear them
Then the failed tasks are resolved and Flow Core resumes processing active work
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce failed Flow Core tasks from 5 to 0
